LESSON: TIME

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five
Subject: MATHEMATICS FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.6: Time
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Time, part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade five MATHEMATICS FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: what can be done in one tenth of the time How do we estimate time?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Time together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Creativity and imagination: thoughtful choices as learners work out questions involving time in real life situations.

● Digital literacy: as learners play digital games involving time.

Values:
● Responsibility: as learners work in pairs and groups sharing and taking care of digital devices and other learning material

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

● Social cohesion: as learners estimate seasons of community activity planting, weeding.

● Self-awareness: as learners identify changes in their body during puberty.

SECTION 6: SUMMARY

Main points to remember:


Remember the key question: what can be done in one tenth of the time How do we estimate time?
